author: Daedalus V
title: Daedalus V - Ablation: Disable Feature Variance Weighting
abstract:
This experiment tests the hypothesis that the inverse variance feature weighting
(`_fw_weight_by_var`) is no longer optimal after my per-gene correction pre-processing.
This run uses the v3 pipeline with feature weighting disabled for both the embedding
and the graph construction paths (alpha=0.0). All other hyperparameters are set
to their optimal values found in previous sweeps.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/daedalus')
from synergy_gene_correction_v3 import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as gene_correction_v3_fn

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData):
  # Ablation Test: Disable feature variance weighting
  return gene_correction_v3_fn(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.65, 
        delta=0.04, 
        kdensity=18, 
        k_total=50,
        correction_alpha=0.1,
        feature_weight_alpha_emb=0.0,
        feature_weight_alpha_graph=0.0,
        rng_seed=1
    )
